# Is your GitHub Actions workflow open to a pwn request or script injection?

> Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find pull_request_target/workflow_run 'pwn request' checkouts and shell script-injection from untrusted ${{ github.event }} expressions. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
